# gocache_general_smart_rule (Resource)

Manages a GoCache general Smart Rule. General Smart Rules apply cache, performance, security and header behaviors to requests that match a set of criteria. Available on the GROWTH plan.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (Attributes) Behaviors applied to requests that match the criteria. At least one attribute should be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action))
- `domain` (String) Domain the Smart Rule belongs to. Example: `gocache.com.br`.
- `match` (Attributes) Criteria that a request must meet for the rule to be applied. At least one attribute should be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--match))

### Optional

- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `notes` (String) Rule description.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Smart Rule identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action`

Optional:

- `backend` (String) Sets the destination IP or hostname. Example: `s3.amazonaws.com`.
- `cache_301` (Boolean) Enable/disable caching of requests with status 301.
- `cache_302` (Boolean) Enable/disable caching of requests with status 302.
- `cache_404` (Boolean) Enable/disable caching of requests with status 404.
- `cache_mode` (String) Cache type (off, static content only, or full cache). Allowed values: `off`, `default`, `full`.
- `cache_ttl` (Number) Cache expiration time, in seconds. Allowed values: `300`, `600`, `900`, `1800`, `3600`, `7200`, `14400`, `86400`, `172800`, `604800`, `1296000`.
- `caching_behavior` (String) Cache behavior. Allowed values: `default`, `ignore_query_string`.
- `connection` (String) Sets the request Connection header. Allowed values: `close`, `keep-alive`.
- `cors` (String) Sets Cross-Origin. Example: `http://www.gocache.com.br`.
- `custom_cache_key` (String) Customizes the cache key. Supports the variables `$cookie_NAME` and `$http_NAME` to use a specific cookie/header value, and `$geoip2_data_country_code`/`$geoip2_data_continent_code` for country/continent. Example: `logado,$cookie_user`. URL parameters `$1`, `$2`, ... can be used when the criteria is a URL with a wildcard.
- `expires_ttl` (Number) Browser cache time, in seconds. The value `-1` disables browser cache. Allowed values: `-1`, `3600`, `7200`, `14400`, `43200`, `86400`, `172800`, `345600`, `604800`, `1296000`, `2592000`, `15552000`, `31536000`.
- `gzip_status` (Boolean) Enable/disable Gzip compression.
- `hide` (String) Removes a response header. The value must be the header name.
- `ignore_cache_control` (Boolean) Enable/disable ignoring the Cache-Control header.
- `ignore_expires` (Boolean) Enable/disable ignoring the Expires header.
- `ignore_vary` (Boolean) Enable/disable ignoring the Vary header.
- `image_optimize` (Boolean) Enable/disable image optimization. Available on the GROWTH plan.
- `image_optimize_level` (Number) Image optimization level. Use `0` to keep the original level, `90` for low, `75` for medium and `65` for high. Available on the GROWTH plan.
- `image_optimize_metadata` (Boolean) Remove image metadata. Available on the GROWTH plan.
- `image_optimize_progressive` (Boolean) Convert JPEG images to the progressive format. Available on the GROWTH plan.
- `image_optimize_webp` (Boolean) Convert images to WEBP. Available on the GROWTH plan.
- `rate_limit_status` (Boolean) Enable/disable the Rate Limit counter. Available on the CUSTOM plan.
- `set` (String) Sets a response header. Example: `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=86400`.
- `set_host` (String) Overrides the request Host header. Example: `mybucket.s3.amazonaws.com`.
- `set_req_header` (List of String) Sets request headers. Example: `X-GoCache-Custom-Header:true`. At most 3 request headers can be specified.
- `set_uri` (String) Overrides the URI. The wildcard (`*`) value from `match.request_uri` can be used through the `$1` variable. Example: `/imagens/$1`.
- `signed_url_key` (String) Sets the signed URL key.
- `signed_url_type` (String) Sets the signed URL type. Allowed values: `s3qs`, `off`.
- `ssl_mode` (String) SSL mode. The value `partial` is equivalent to Edge mode. Allowed values: `partial`, `full`.
- `waf_level` (String) WAF protection level. Allowed values: `low`, `medium`, `high`. Available on the GROWTH plan.
- `waf_mode` (String) WAF operation mode. Allowed values: `block`, `simulate`, `challenge`. Available on the GROWTH plan.
- `waf_status` (Boolean) Enable/disable the WAF. Available on the GROWTH plan.


<a id="nestedatt--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `match`

Optional:

- `cookie` (String) Match when one or more cookies from a list are present. Separate multiple cookies with a comma. Supports the wildcard (`*`). Example: `wp_login,wp_test`.
- `cookie_content` (String) Match when a cookie has a specific value. Name and value are separated by an equals sign (`=`). Supports the wildcard (`*`) in the cookie value. Example: `wp_test=yes`.
- `device_type` (List of String) Type of the device performing the request. Allowed values: `desktop`, `mobile`, `bot`, `na`.
- `header` (String) Match when the request has a specific header. Name and value are separated by a colon (`:`). Supports the wildcard (`*`) in the header value. Example: `Accept:*`.
- `host` (String) Domain/subdomain used to access the site. Example: `www.gocache.com.br`.
- `http_referer` (String) Referer of the request.
- `http_user_agent` (String) User agent of the request. Supports the wildcard (`*`). Example: `*Mozilla*`.
- `http_version` (List of String) HTTP version used in the request. Allowed values: `HTTP/1.0`, `HTTP/1.1`, `HTTP/2.0`.
- `origin_asn` (Number) ASN of the requester, represented only by numbers.
- `origin_continent` (List of String) Continent of origin. Allowed values: `SA`, `NA`, `OC`, `EU`, `AF`, `AS`.
- `origin_country` (String) Country of origin (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code). Multiple values can be combined with a pipe (`|`). Example: `US|UK`.
- `remote_address` (String) Source IP or IP range of the request. For ranges, only the masks `/32`, `/24` and `/16` are available.
- `request_method` (List of String) HTTP request method. Allowed values: `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`.
- `request_uri` (String) Request URI. Supports the wildcard (`*`). Example: `/admin/*`.
- `scheme` (String) Access protocol. Allowed values: `http`, `https`, `http*`.
